dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section to a sharp vertex at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical lateral margins with smooth convex expansions at the anterior pectoral region and no visible asymmetrical deviations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone; high-intensity median pixel reflectance across the entire dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark, linear contrast disruption is visible along the central dorsal axis, approximately mid-body.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A shallow, longitudinal depression/groove coinciding with the dark mark on the central dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single dark-grey linear scar or persistent mark located on the mid-dorsal ridge.
